statement: The control-plane readiness service is one class whose collaborators (system-table cache, planning snapshot source, node service rows, clock) are named constructor parameters validated once at construction, replacing the nine-deep extends chain across the 24 control-plane-readiness-*.js files; the planning-answer chain (getMembershipPublicationPlanningAnswerSync, getPriorityRecoveryPlanningAnswerSync and their snapshot forms) is one method with one name, and its three consumers (partition-service-learner-promotion-methods.js, replica-operation-repository-visibility-methods.js, unified-rebalancer-available-nodes.js) call it without typeof checks; readiness behaviour and every existing witness are unchanged.

constraints.statement: No readiness verdict, timing, cache key or publication changes. Existing readiness witnesses pass with construction-only edits.
Collaborator interfaces are validated in the constructor and nowhere else; a missing collaborator is a construction refusal, never a runtime fallback or a null-returning getter.
The four-way planning-answer chain collapses to one method. Aliases and compatibility paths are deleted, not kept.
The src/ changes land only behind an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
